First, we find the two numbers in the table that $0.3725$ lies between. These numbers are $0.3707$ and $0.3745.$ So, we have the following inequality:

$$
\begin{aligned}0.3707 & <0.3725<0.3745\end{aligned}
$$

Writing the above inequality in terms of $Φ,$ we have

$$
\begin{aligned}Φ(-0.33) & <Φ(z)<Φ(-0.32).\end{aligned}
$$

So, using interval bisection, we can approximate $z$ as

$$
z≈\frac{-0.33+(-0.32)}{2}=-0.325.
$$
